upstream.description: ChatDev 2.0: Dev All through LLM-powered Multi-Agent Collaboration

classification.analysis: ChatDev 2.0 (DevAll) is a zero-code multi-agent orchestration platform where users configure agents, workflows, and tasks through a web console to automate complex work such as data visualization, 3D generation, and deep research; the legacy ChatDev 1.0 (on a separate branch) simulated a virtual software company with CEO/CTO/Programmer agents automating the full SDLC. The backend is Python/uv with a Vue 3 + Vite frontend, Docker Compose deployment, and integration hooks for coding-agent tools that can invoke or create ChatDev workflows. Backed by OpenBMB with an associated NeurIPS paper on evolving multi-agent orchestration; a large, long-running research-to-product project with over 34,000 stars.

use_cases.title: Build a no-code multi-agent workflow for a custom task
Automate a research or content pipeline with agent teams
